response.sql: WITH acc AS (SELECT t.account_id, AVG(t.amount) AS acc_avg FROM trans t GROUP BY t.account_id), reg AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(acc.acc_avg) AS region_figure FROM acc JOIN account a ON a.account_id = acc.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(region_figure) AS overall_avg FROM reg) SELECT reg.region, reg.region_figure, reg.region_figure - overall.overall_avg AS excess_over_average, reg.region_figure / overall.overall_avg AS ratio_to_average FROM reg CROSS JOIN overall WHERE reg.region_figure > overall.overall_avg
